uncited: * Face Coloring: An implicit coloring scheme derived from the DMC method is used to assign a color ID to each element.
* Counter Buffer: For the 3-X-3-Y pattern, an integer buffer with one entry per vertex acts as a counter.
Compute Vertex Valence: A kernel iterates through all halfedges.
Mark Elements (Initial): A kernel processes elements.
Find Remaining Elements: A buffer with an integer entry per vertex and a counter is used.
The counter tracks how often quadrilaterals with the 3-X-3-Y pattern share a valence-3 vertex.
Remove Vertices: A vertex-wise kernel copies vertices to a new buffer if they are not marked for removal.
Remove Elements: An element-wise kernel copies quadrilaterals to a new element buffer if not marked for removal.
Mark Vertices and Elements: A kernel processes the mesh element-wise.
For each element, it tests if all four vertices have valence 3.
If so, it reconstructs the complete neighborhood.
